title: make the base test command green
body: Outcome: the repository's own test command exits 0 on a clean checkout of the base.

Why: adoption found a red base: red base: the repository's own test command `WP_CORE_DIR=/mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside-public/wp-core vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/CloudProvider/Aws/LambdaClientTest.php` exits 127 on the clean outside/wp-plugin tree, so the Stop gate cannot pass it; make it pass (install the dependencies) and rerun. sh: line 1: vendor/bin/phpunit: No such file or directory
Proof: the test command in krn.json exits 0 on the delivered tree.
